name: Twilight Shore (Darkshore)
summary: Murloc tribes and hungry sea creatures crowd the Twilight Shore in southern Darkshore. The rugged coast runs from the Long Wash to Ashenvale, where misty beaches meet cliffs, islets, and dangerous surf.

sections.title: A Treacherous Coastline
sections.body: The Twilight Shore runs south from the Long Wash, past Ameth'Aran's ruins, toward Ashenvale. Gray beaches give way to sharp cliffs and rocky islands. Threshadons and sea crawlers prowl the waters, while aggressive murloc camps line the shore.

faq.q: Where is the Twilight Shore located?
faq.answer: The Twilight Shore runs along Darkshore's southern coast, beginning south of the Long Wash, roughly west of Ameth'Aran's ruins, and reaching the rocky border of Ashenvale.

faq.q: What threats can be found along the Twilight Shore?
faq.answer: Aggressive murloc tribes crowd the shore. In the cold surf, threshadons, lurkers, and giant crabs prey on unwary travelers.

faq.q: Why is the terrain so rugged here?
faq.answer: The Veiled Sea's relentless pounding has broken the coast into sharp cliffs, rocky shoals, and small offshore islands. Farther north, the beaches are flatter and more open.

angles.text: As a night elf, you reach the lonely, mist-shrouded border between Darkshore's haunted ruins and Ashenvale's ancestral forests.
